about: LIN-3188: each detector's verdict on every incident on record (what-hides-between-sessions-register.json) whose pattern it targets and whose onset falls inside the detector's data window, hand-called by the author from the alarms scripts/survey-hides-analyse.mjs --near lists within 2 h before to 24 h after the onset (30 h when the onset is a date only), read against each incident's description. hit: an alarm in that window is the incident (same sessions, ticket or mechanism). miss: none is. Where an alarm is plausible but its sessions could not be tied to the incident, the call is miss, so hits are a floor. Alarms not tied to any incident were coded by the scripts' own readers (d2-codes.json, d7-codes.json) or, for D1, by signature class: auth and transient episodes are real errors seen by three or more sessions; client episodes (a repeated request mistake, e.g. 'no valid fields to update') are false alarms of a rule that does not exclude 4xx request errors.
